name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: Your friend will see this name. You can change it later in settings.

demo.title: Take a look

lines.hello: When do you think our egg will hatch?
lines.talk: They say it hatches if we talk a lot!
lines.weekend: Let’s feed it together this weekend too

demo.endBody: Ready to raise your own buddy? Start right away, no sign-up.

banner.title: 🥚 How to raise your buddy
banner.body: It grows as you chat and take care of it, with a bonus when you both talk on the same day. A reward appears on the stage every 5 levels, and at level 30 it can go its own way.

care.title: 🍚 Care
care.feed: When it is hungry the bowl is empty. Tap the bowl, or send just "food" in the chat.
care.clean: Each tap cleans up one 💩. Send "clean" in the chat to clean them all.
care.pet: Tap your buddy and it cheers, dances or sings.

grow.title: 🌱 Growing
grow.exp: EXP: +1 per message (up to 50 a day), +2 for a meal, +2 per 💩 cleaned.
grow.stages: Egg → baby (Lv.3) → child (Lv.10) → adult (Lv.20). From child on, it talks.
grow.together: When you both send a message on the same day, you get a together bonus of +{{exp}} EXP once a day. 🤝

rewards.title: 🎁 Level rewards
rewards.body: Every 5 levels the stage gets a little finer.

graduate.title: 🎓 Its own way
graduate.top: The top level is 30. Then you can let your buddy go its own way from its details.
graduate.album: It stays in the album and hangs on the wall in a frame. A new egg comes to the stage.
graduate.keep: The rewards you collected stay with the new egg.
